name: riven-social
description: Riven promo videos for TikTok, Instagram Reels, and YouTube Shorts

scripts.render:all: npm run render:exam-panic && npm run render:seed-reward && npm run render:garden-loop && npm run render:skin-reveal && npm run render:study-with-me
scripts.render:exam-panic: npx remotion render src/index.ts ExamPanic out/exam-panic.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:seed-reward: npx remotion render src/index.ts SeedReward out/seed-reward.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:garden-loop: npx remotion render src/index.ts GardenLoop out/garden-loop.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:skin-reveal: npx remotion render src/index.ts DeckSkinReveal out/skin-reveal.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.render:study-with-me: npx remotion render src/index.ts StudyWithMe out/study-with-me.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=18
scripts.preview:exam-panic: npx remotion render src/index.ts ExamPanic out/preview.mp4 --codec=h264 --crf=28 --scale=0.5
